body:
# ✨ NeoneX: Essential Commands and Quality-of-Life Utilities

**NeoneX** is a modern, lightweight utility mod built specifically for the **Forge** modding framework on the latest versions of Minecraft.

It focuses on delivering powerful, yet simple-to-use, commands and essential quality-of-life features to streamline server administration and enhance the exploration experience.

Whether you are managing a small private server or looking for efficient tools in your single-player world, NeoneX provides reliable functionality designed to save time and give operators precise control.

---

## 🚀 Currently Available Commands

NeoneX implements new, powerful console commands for operators (Permission Level 2):

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`/explode <strength> [pos]`** | Executes an explosion with custom strength (0.1 - 100.0). |
| **`/teleportto <biome>`** | Instantly finds and teleports you to the nearest specified biome. |
| **`/heal`** | Fully restores your health and food levels. |
| **`/feed`** | Fully restores your hunger and saturation levels. |
| **`/day`** | Sets the world time to morning (1000). |
| **`/night`** | Sets the world time to nightfall (13000). |
| **`/gmc`** | Quick shortcut to switch to **Creative Mode**. |
| **`/gms`** | Quick shortcut to switch to **Survival Mode**. |
| **`/repair`** | Fully repairs the item currently held in your main hand. |

---

## 🛠️ Mod Philosophy & Commitment

NeoneX is built with stability and performance in mind, utilizing modern Forge development practices.

**Commitment to Growth:**
This mod is actively maintained and designed to be expandable. Even with these new additions, **expect more commands and utility features to be added soon** as development time allows, further enhancing server control and player convenience.

---

**Note:** This mod is required on both the client and the server.
